annotations.title: Plan costs as the workload changes

description: Use this when: the user asks how the cost changes as the workload grows or shifts, or at what volume another plan becomes the cheapest. Do not use this when: the workload is fixed (use search). Show how API plan costs change when the monthly workload changes, for example twice the pages or a larger share of JavaScript pages. Along the path from the current to a target workload it returns the cheapest fully matching plan at both ends, each workload where the cheapest plan changes, and for tracked plans where the cost first steps up, where the plan can no longer cover the volume and where the budget is exceeded. Costs follow published pricing rules (whole packs of extra credits, per-period pack limits, per-connection browser billing, monthly minimums) with official source sentences. Example: 10,000 searches a month growing to 200,000.

ai_extraction_pages.description: How many of the pages need their fields extracted by an AI model (from a prompt or a schema, or automatically) without writing selectors. Each page counts in one of the two extraction fields.

api_auth_methods.description: Ways a request to the provider's API can be authenticated (not the MCP endpoint, which is mcp_auth). Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

api_key_restrictions.description: API key restrictions (scopes, IP allowlist, quotas). Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

api_transports.description: Transports the API offers for a product (e.g. WebSocket, REST). Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

async_delivery.description: Ways results of a scraping or crawl job are delivered asynchronously: polling a job ID, callback or webhook, WebSocket, cloud storage, batch. Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

automation_frameworks.description: Browser automation libraries and protocols the hosted browser accepts (CDP, Puppeteer, Playwright, Selenium, Stagehand). Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

billing_currency.description: The currency the vendor bills fees in (e.g. USD). Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

billing_types.description: Acceptable billing: monthly_subscription (A plan with a fixed fee (or minimum commitment) billed every month.) annual_subscription (A plan paid for a year at a time.) pay_as_you_go (No plan fee; a price per unit of use, billed after use or drawn from a balance topped up with any amount.) prepaid_credits (Money paid before use: a credit pack, a balance topped up first, or a plan amount charged in advance for the period.) Free plans always qualify.

browser_engine.description: Kind of browser or engine pages are fetched with (plain HTTP, headless or headful Chromium, proprietary engine, fingerprint profiles). Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

browser_seconds_per_page.description: Browser time per page in seconds, for headless-browser products billed by time. Every plan must then serve pages that take this long: a hosted browser does, a request-based API only when one request may run that long.

captcha_solving.description: The plan must solve CAPTCHAs for the browser sessions (the vendor does it, not the buyer own service).

clone_sample_formats.description: Audio file formats the voice cloning sample upload must accept. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

cloud_marketplace_billing.description: Whether the vendor's service can be bought and billed through third-party cloud platforms or marketplaces. Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

content_filtering_options.description: Options that narrow what page content is returned: CSS selectors to keep or drop, main content only, maximum characters, removing images, iframes and shadow DOM, link summaries. Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

data_regions.description: Regions where data must be stored or processed, e.g. ["EU"]. Different from exit-IP countries.

detail.description: summary returns one source sentence per fact; full returns every recorded fact and sentence.

device_emulation.description: Devices, user agents or browser locales the request can emulate (desktop, mobile, tablet, specific browsers). Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

exit_ip_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of countries the page requests must exit from, e.g. ["US","DE"]. For search results of a country use search_countries.

failed_requests_not_billed.description: Requests that fail on the provider side (timeouts, blocks, 5xx) must not be billed. A flat monthly price for unlimited requests meets it, since no request is billed on its own; when only success-based billing will do, use only_successful_requests_billed.

language_filter.description: Languages a search can be restricted to or boosted for, and interface languages. Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

machine_payments.description: Machine payment protocols (x402, MPP, stablecoin) through which an agent can pay per request without creating an account, and the rules for such balances. Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

max_agent_search_price_per_1k.description: Price of web search or URL-fetch tool calls made inside the vendor's agent, LLM or sandbox API, billed per tool invocation. Agent tool call price: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_ai_extraction_price_per_1k.description: Price of LLM-based processing of a fetched page into a summary or schema-shaped JSON, charged per page on top of the fetch. AI extraction price: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_answer_price_per_1k.description: Price of an LLM-generated answer grounded in live web search results (answer or chat-completions endpoint), excluding any separately listed token charges. Answer price per 1,000 requests: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_breach_notification_hours.description: How and how fast the vendor tells customers about a security incident or data breach. Breach notification time: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_clone_sample_seconds.description: Seconds of audio you can supply for a voice clone, for text-to-speech. Met when the shortest sample the provider accepts is at most this long.

max_credit_topup_usd.description: The most you want to pay for the smallest credit top-up, in US dollars. Met when the provider's smallest top-up is at most this much.

max_email_validation_price_per_1k.description: Price of address validations beyond the included ones, by volume bracket. Email validation price: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_first_response_latency_ms.description: Time to first response. Time to first response: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_input_token_usd_per_1m.description: Token price per 1M. Token price per 1M: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_monitor_check_price_per_1k.description: Price of scheduled monitoring runs that repeat a search or page check and report changes. Scheduled monitoring price: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_monthly_cost_usd.description: Monthly budget in USD before tax. Compared with listed prices; annual plans use their per-month equivalent.

max_overage_usd_per_1k.description: The most the plan may charge for each 1,000 emails beyond its included volume, in USD, for transactional email. A plan whose extra price is not published as a per-1,000 figure is unknown.

max_page_content_price_per_1k.description: Price of fetching the content of a given URL as clean text or markdown through a contents, extract or context endpoint (not a search). Page content price: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_response_cache_seconds.description: How long the vendor serves an identical request from its cache by default instead of fetching again. Default cache duration: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_voice_clone_fee_usd.description: The most the provider may charge for each cloned voice, in US dollars (0 = no fee per voice).

mcp_auth.description: Ways to authenticate to the provider's hosted MCP endpoint, any one of which will do: api_key, oauth. Met when the endpoint accepts at least one of them; implies a hosted endpoint.

min_api_keys.description: Number of API keys an account or plan may create. API keys: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_batch_send.description: Most emails one API request can send in a batch. Emails per batch request: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_builtin_voices.description: Built-in voices. Built-in voices: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_concurrency.description: Minimum number of concurrent requests (or browsers) the plan must allow.

min_concurrent_streaming_sessions.description: Streaming sessions the plan must allow at the same time, for text-to-speech. Met when the stated limit is at least this many.

min_contacts_included.description: Subscribed or marketing contacts the plan covers (minimum and maximum of the plan's contact range where stated). Marketing contacts included: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_content_tokens_per_request.description: Most page-content tokens one request returns (total and per URL), or the token budget the buyer can set. Content tokens per request: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_custom_voices.description: Custom voices the plan must let one account create (cloned or designed), for text-to-speech. Met when the stated limit is at least this many (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_daily_email_limit.description: Most emails the account may send in one day (24 hours) on this plan or by default, unlimited when the page says so; adjustable or reputation-based limits keep that condition. Emails per day: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_discontinuation_notice_months.description: Months of notice the provider must give before it discontinues a service, model or API version the buyer uses.

min_domain_filter_include.description: Include, exclude or boost domain lists for a search, with the most domains allowed. Search domain filters: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_email_validations_included.description: Address validations included per month on the plan. Email validations included per month: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_free_credit_days.description: How long after account creation free-tier credits remain usable before they expire. Free credit expiry: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_free_plan_months.description: How long after account creation the free plan remains available. How long the free plan lasts: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_free_trial_days.description: Days of free trial the provider must give. Met when the stated trial is at least this long.

min_job_results_retention_days.description: Job results kept (days). Job results kept (days): Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_liability_cap_usd.description: The provider's liability under its terms must be capped at no less than this many US dollars (the fixed floor of the cap, where the cap is the greater of a floor and the fees paid).

min_log_retention_days.description: Days the plan must keep the logs or events of sent email where the account can read them, for transactional email. Longer retention sold as an add-on does not count.

min_log_retention_max_days.description: Longest log and activity retention the plan can be set to or can buy (the default retention is log_retention_days). Longest log retention available: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_message_content_retention_days.description: Days the full message body is kept by default, stated apart from the log events. Message content retention: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_message_size_mb.description: Largest message, attachments included, the vendor accepts on the plan. Largest message size (MB): Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_pages_per_crawl.description: Pages one crawl job (from one start URL, following links) must be able to reach. A plan whose crawl has no page cap meets any number; give the size of the largest site to crawl. Different from the monthly page total.

min_pages_per_doc.description: Pages one document may have at the most the plan allows, for document parsing. Met when the stated limit is at least this many (or the pages say there is no page limit); a plan whose pages do not state a limit is unknown. The limit of the largest way of sending (batch or asynchronous) counts.

min_plan_monthly_emails.description: Largest monthly email volume the plan can be raised to, with the price of that top tier. Largest monthly email volume: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_plan_rate_discount_pct.description: Plan discount on usage rates. Plan discount on usage rates: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_price_increase_notice_days.description: Days of notice the provider must give before it raises prices or fees for the services the buyer uses.

min_pro_voice_clones.description: Professional voice clones the plan must include, for text-to-speech. Met when the stated limit is at least this many.

min_reachable_results.description: How deep the buyer can page through results of one query (offset or page limit). Result paging depth: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_refund_request_days.description: How long after purchase a customer may still request a refund. Refund request window: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_requests_per_minute.description: Minimum request rate the plan must allow, per minute.

min_results_per_search.description: Most results one search request can return (the stated maximum, not the default). Results per search: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_send_rate_per_second.description: Most emails the vendor accepts per second from the account (not API requests per second). Email sending rate: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_sending_domains.description: Sending domains the plan must let one account authenticate, for transactional email. Met when the stated limit is at least this many (or the pages say it is unlimited); a plan whose pages do not state a limit is unknown.

min_session_idle_seconds.description: How long an idle or disconnected browser session stays alive before it closes (default and longest configurable). Idle browser session timeout: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_session_minutes.description: Minutes one browser session must be able to run on this plan, for hosted browsers. Met when the stated longest session of the plan is at least this long; a plan whose pages do not state a session limit is unknown, and a limit the page gives only for another plan is not met.

min_startup_credits_usd.description: Startup program credits. Startup program credits: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_subprocessor_change_notice_days.description: Days of notice before the vendor adds or replaces a sub-processor, with the right to object where stated. Notice before a sub-processor change: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_terms_update_notice_days.description: Days of notice the provider must give before a change of its terms applies to the buyer (0 in the record means the change applies without notice).

min_voice_cloning_rpm.description: Voice cloning request rate limit. Voice cloning request rate limit: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_webhook_endpoints.description: Webhook endpoints (event destinations) the plan allows. Webhook endpoints: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_websocket_connections.description: Open WebSocket connections. Open WebSocket connections: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_websocket_idle_minutes.description: WebSocket idle timeout (minutes). WebSocket idle timeout (minutes): Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_workspace_seats.description: Seats (team members) one workspace on the plan must be able to have. Met when the stated limit is at least this many (or the pages say there is no limit).

monthly_pages.description: Pages per month by type: plain_html (static pages), javascript (needs rendering), premium_proxy (blocked sites that need residential/premium proxies), javascript_premium_proxy (both).

monthly_pages_total.description: Total pages per month when the split by type is not known yet. Costs and verdicts then cover every share of JavaScript-rendered pages from 0% to 100% of the total (no premium proxies), and the result lists monthly_pages under needs_input.

monthly_searches.description: Search requests per month (one results page each).

needs_access_until_period_end_after_canc.description: After cancelling, the buyer must keep access until the end of the period already paid for.

needs_agent_skills_plugin.description: The vendor publishes official skills or plugins that teach AI coding agents to use its email API. The plan must have it (Official AI agent skills or plugin).

needs_api_access_without_subscription.description: Whether the API can be used without buying a subscription plan. The plan must have it (API use without a subscription).

needs_attribution_required.description: Whether content made with the service must credit the vendor when published, and whether that attribution may be removed. The plan must have it (Vendor attribution required).

needs_auto_recharge.description: Prepaid credits must be able to top up automatically when the balance falls below a threshold.

needs_automatic_language_detection.description: Whether speech recognition detects the spoken language automatically without it being specified. The plan must have it (Automatic language detection).

needs_batch.description: The plan must transcribe recorded audio (a file or a stored recording), for speech-to-text. A plan priced for live audio only is not met.

needs_batch_discount.description: An official page must say a batch or asynchronous way of sending documents costs less than the list price on the plan, for document parsing. The budget and the cost are judged at the list price, not at the batch price.

needs_bidirectional_text_streaming.description: The API must accept text as a stream (for example tokens from a language model) while it speaks, for text-to-speech.

needs_billing_account_required.description: Payment method required to start. The plan must have it (Payment method required to start).

needs_bounce_classification.description: Bounces are categorized by type or reason. The plan must have it (Bounce classification).

needs_browser_access_tokens.description: The API must offer tokens that let a browser or client call it without exposing the secret API key.

needs_business_use_only.description: The licence must be limited to business use (no personal use).

needs_cache_max_age_control.description: The buyer can set the maximum age of cached content or bypass the cache to force a fresh fetch. The plan must have it (Cache freshness control).

needs_cached_results_billing.description: Whether results served from the vendor's cache are billed or free. The plan must have it (Cached results billed).

needs_cancel_anytime.description: The buyer must be able to cancel at any time, with no fixed term (an official line says so).

needs_cancellation_method.description: How the customer cancels a subscription (e.g. self-serve in account settings, or by contacting the vendor). The plan must have it (Self-serve cancellation).

needs_cc_bcc_support.description: Emails can carry CC/BCC copies, including automatic BCC of a domain's mail. The plan must have it (CC/BCC copies).

needs_ccpa_compliant.description: The provider must state that it complies with the CCPA (California privacy law).

needs_code_switching_within_sentence.description: The service must let one voice switch between languages inside one sentence.

needs_commercial_use.description: The plan must allow commercial use of the generated audio, for text-to-speech. A free plan limited to non-commercial use does not count; a plan whose pages do not say is unknown.

needs_competing_product_use_prohibited.description: The terms forbid using the service or its output to research or build competing products. The plan must have it (Use to build competing products prohibited).

needs_cost_reported_per_request.description: Each response reports what that request cost or whether it was billed (a header or a field with credits, dollars or browser time used). The plan must have it (Cost shown per request).

needs_credits_kept_on_plan_change.description: Unused paid credits must stay in the balance when the buyer changes plan.

needs_custom_headers_cookies.description: The buyer can send its own headers, cookies, user agent or referer with a scraping request. The plan must have it (Custom headers and cookies).

needs_custom_pricing.description: The plan (usually Enterprise) has no listed price; price is set by contract or by contacting sales. The plan must have it (Custom (contract) pricing).

needs_data_deleted_on_account_deletion.description: The provider must delete the buyer's data when the account is deleted.

needs_date_filter.description: Filters on result freshness or publication date (past hour/day/week, custom date range). The plan must have it (Search date filter).

needs_dedicated_account_manager.description: The plan must come with a dedicated account manager.

needs_dedicated_ip.description: The plan must come with a dedicated sending IP address, for transactional email. A dedicated IP sold only as an add-on on top of the plan, or only on another plan, does not count.

needs_dedicated_ip_pools.description: Dedicated IPs can be grouped into pools to keep reputations apart, for example marketing and transactional mail. The plan must have it (Dedicated IP pools).

needs_dedicated_ip_warmup.description: The vendor warms up dedicated IPs automatically (false when the buyer must raise volume manually). The plan must have it (Automatic dedicated IP warmup).

needs_dedicated_support_channel.description: The plan must include a dedicated support channel with the provider.

needs_deliverability_expert_help.description: Help from the vendor's deliverability experts: included hours, yearly assessments, a dedicated deliverability manager, setup help, or sold separately. The plan must have it (Deliverability expert help).

needs_deliverability_insights.description: Insights and recommendations on mail sent through the vendor (delivery rates, engagement, issues) included on the plan. The plan must have it (Deliverability insights).

needs_diarization.description: The plan must label who spoke (speaker diarization), for speech-to-text. Where the vendor charges extra for it, the extra price is added to the monthly cost; where the pages state no price or no inclusion the plan is unknown.

needs_domain_authentication.description: Sending domains are authenticated with SPF, DKIM and DMARC, with automated key management where stated. The plan must have it (Domain authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)).

needs_downgrade_at_period_end.description: A downgrade of the plan must take effect at the end of the paid period.

needs_dpa.description: The vendor must offer a data processing agreement (DPA) to the buyer.

needs_email_templates.description: Hosted email templates with an editor (and template testing where stated). The plan must have it (Hosted email templates).

needs_email_validation.description: Email address validation (by API or automatically before sending), included on the plan or sold as an add-on. The plan must have it (Email address validation).

needs_emotion_control.description: The service must let the buyer control the emotion or expressiveness of the generated speech.

needs_encryption_in_transit_and_at_rest.description: The provider must state that data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

needs_eu_us_data_privacy_framework.description: EU-US Data Privacy Framework. The plan must have it (EU-US Data Privacy Framework).

needs_fips_140_validation.description: Whether FIPS 140 validated cryptography or images are offered, and for which deployment types. The plan must have it (FIPS 140 validated cryptography).

needs_gdpr_compliant.description: The provider must state that it complies with the GDPR.

needs_generated_answer.description: The search response can include an LLM-written answer grounded in the results. The plan must have it (LLM-generated answer in search response).

needs_hipaa_baa.description: The provider must offer a signed HIPAA business associate agreement (BAA) for the plan (a BAA sold only as an add-on is met on the plan the record says has it).

needs_idempotency_keys.description: Send requests can carry an idempotency key so a retry never sends twice, with the key lifetime where stated. The plan must have it (Idempotency keys).

needs_inbound.description: The service must receive email for the buyer and hand it on (inbound parsing, routes), for transactional email.

needs_inbound_counts_toward_quota.description: Received emails count against the plan's email allowance. The plan must have it (Received emails count toward the email quota).

needs_inbound_spam_virus_filtering.description: Spam, virus or IP-reputation filtering of incoming email, included on the plan or as an add-on, with any size limit. The plan must have it (Inbound spam and virus filtering).

needs_inbox_placement_monitoring.description: Inbox placement (seed list) testing and blocklist or reputation monitoring beyond the vendor's own sending stats, included on the plan or sold as an add-on or separate product. The plan must have it (Inbox placement and blocklist monitoring).

needs_input_ownership.description: The terms must say the buyer keeps the rights to the content the buyer sends in.

needs_ip_allowlisting.description: Account or API access can be limited to listed IP addresses. The plan must have it (IP allowlisting).

needs_ip_indemnity.description: The provider must indemnify the buyer against intellectual-property claims over the service or its output.

needs_iso27001.description: The provider must be certified to ISO/IEC 27001.

needs_keyless_access.description: Some endpoints can be called without an API key or account, at a lower rate limit, with the endpoints that still need a key stated. The plan must have it (Use without an API key).

needs_korean.description: The service must voice Korean text (text-to-speech) or transcribe Korean speech (speech-to-text).

needs_language_override_param.description: The API must accept a language or locale parameter that sets the language of the synthesis.

needs_link_branding.description: Tracked links use the buyer's own (HTTPS) domain instead of the vendor's, with any condition such as a dedicated IP. The plan must have it (Branded tracking links (own domain)).

needs_live_fetch.description: Results or page contents are fetched live at request time rather than only served from a pre-built index. The plan must have it (Live fetching at request time).

needs_live_view.description: The buyer can watch or take control of a running browser session live. The plan must have it (Live browser session view).

needs_log_retention_addon.description: Longer log or activity history can be bought as an add-on on this plan. The plan must have it (Longer log retention as an add-on).

needs_long_form_synthesis.description: The service must support synthesizing long texts (for example audiobooks or chapters), for text-to-speech.

needs_migration_assistance.description: The vendor helps move from another provider or onboard (free above a stated volume, guides otherwise). The plan must have it (Migration assistance).

needs_multi_speaker_dialogue.description: The API must produce a conversation between several speakers in one request, for text-to-speech.

needs_no_min_billing.description: An official page must say audio is billed by the second (or an increment of seconds) with no minimum billed duration per request, for speech-to-text. A page that says nothing about rounding is unknown.

needs_no_training.description: An official page must say the vendor does not use the buyer's text, audio or documents to train its models without the buyer opting in. A use that is on by default with an opt-out to ask for does not count.

needs_nonverbal_tags.description: The service must support nonverbal sounds (for example laughter or sighs) through tags in the text.

needs_official_mcp.description: The provider must publish its own MCP server (hosted by it or run by the buyer), stated in its official documentation. A server only a third party published does not count.

needs_on_prem_deployment.description: The service must be deployable on the buyer's own infrastructure (on-premises or self-hosted).

needs_openai_compatible_api.description: The vendor exposes an endpoint compatible with the OpenAI API shape (e.g. /audio/transcriptions). The plan must have it (OpenAI-compatible API).

needs_organizations.description: The plan must support organizations, teams or workspaces with several members.

needs_output_for_ai_training_prohibited.description: The terms must forbid using the generated audio to train AI models.

needs_output_ownership.description: The terms must say the buyer owns the output the service generates.

needs_overage_toggle.description: Pay-as-you-go overage can be switched on or off. The plan must have it (Pay-as-you-go overage can be switched on or off).

needs_own_search_index.description: Results come from the vendor's own web index rather than from scraping Google or Bing. The plan must have it (Own search index).

needs_pause_control.description: The service must let the buyer insert or control pauses (breaks) in the generated speech.

needs_pci_dss.description: The provider must state PCI DSS compliance.

needs_pdf_document_parsing.description: The scraper reads PDF and other documents found at a URL (or uploaded) and returns their text. The plan must have it (PDF and document reading).

needs_penetration_testing.description: The vendor runs regular third-party penetration tests or a bug bounty program. The plan must have it (Penetration testing or bug bounty).

needs_price_locked_for_current_period.description: The price must stay fixed for the period already paid.

needs_priority_support.description: The plan must include priority support.

needs_pronunciation_dictionary.description: The plan must let the buyer set custom pronunciations of words (a lexicon or pronunciation dictionary), for text-to-speech.

needs_quota_increase_on_request.description: The provider must let the buyer request higher quotas or limits.

needs_recurring_free_tier.description: The plan must be usable every month without paying (a free plan with a monthly allowance or a monthly free credit).

needs_remote_mcp.description: The provider must host a remote MCP endpoint (a URL an MCP client connects to). An official server that can only be run on the buyer own machine does not meet it.

needs_reputation_isolation.description: A problem in one sending domain is kept from harming the whole account (a safeguard policy for multi-domain or SaaS senders). The plan must have it (Sending reputation isolated per domain or tenant).

needs_reputation_monitoring.description: The vendor monitors the buyer's sending IP or domain reputation as a service on this plan. The plan must have it (Sending reputation monitoring).

needs_safe_search.description: Explicit-content filtering of search results. The plan must have it (Safe search filtering).

needs_scim_provisioning.description: Automated provisioning of users and roles from the customer's identity provider via SCIM. The plan must have it (SCIM user provisioning).

needs_sending_requires_account_approval.description: A new account may send only after the vendor approves it or moves it out of a restricted sandbox. The plan must have it (Account approval needed before sending).

needs_separate_bulk_stream.description: Bulk or broadcast email is sent through a stream or infrastructure kept separate from transactional email. The plan must have it (Separate bulk email stream).

needs_session_reuse.description: A buyer can reconnect to and reuse an existing browser session instead of launching a new one. The plan must have it (Reconnect to an existing browser session).

needs_shared_credit_pool.description: One credit balance must be shared across several products of the provider.

needs_shared_send_allowance.description: Transactional and marketing (broadcast) email draw on one allowance or one price; false when they are counted separately. The plan must have it (Marketing and transactional email share one allowance).

needs_signed_webhooks.description: The plan must deliver webhooks that the buyer can verify by a signature (a signing secret or a signed endpoint).

needs_sla.description: The plan must come with a service level agreement (SLA).

needs_soc2.description: The provider must hold a SOC 2 report: true for Type I or Type II, "II" for Type II.

needs_spam_complaint_tracking.description: Spam complaints are collected from mailbox-provider feedback loops into the buyer's stats. The plan must have it (Spam complaint tracking (ISP feedback loops)).

needs_spend_limits.description: Spending limit. The plan must have it (Spending limit).

needs_ssml_parsing.description: The service must accept SSML markup in the input text.

needs_sso.description: The plan must include single sign-on (SSO) for the team.

needs_standard_contractual_clauses.description: Whether international transfers of personal data are covered by the EU Standard Contractual Clauses. The plan must have it (EU Standard Contractual Clauses).

needs_streaming.description: The service must return audio in real time as it is made (streaming or a WebSocket), for text-to-speech; for speech-to-text, it must transcribe live audio as it arrives. A speech-to-text price line is per mode, so a plan priced for recorded audio only is not met.

needs_streaming_response.description: The API can stream results as they are produced (server-sent events or stream mode). The plan must have it (Streamed API responses).

needs_sub_accounts.description: Sub-accounts, subusers or tenants separate teams, brands or end customers under one account (with central billing where stated), included or as an add-on. The plan must have it (Sub-accounts).

needs_support_24_7.description: Days and hours during which the vendor's support channels are staffed. The plan must have it (Support hours).

needs_suppression_management.description: Bounced, complained and unsubscribed addresses are suppressed automatically, the list can be managed, and how long it is kept. The plan must have it (Automatic suppression list).

needs_table_extraction.description: The service must return the tables of a page as structure (rows and cells), not only the text, for document parsing.

needs_test_sandbox.description: A test mode, sandbox or mailbox simulator where emails are captured or simulated instead of delivered, and how it is billed. The plan must have it (Test sandbox).

needs_text_normalization.description: The API must read numbers, dates and abbreviations out as words (text normalization), for text-to-speech.

needs_training_opt_out.description: The buyer must be able to opt out of having their data used to train models.

needs_two_factor_auth.description: Sign-in to the account can require two-factor or multi-factor authentication. The plan must have it (Two-factor sign-in (2FA/MFA)).

needs_upgrade_credits_immediate.description: On upgrade, the new tier's credits are added to the balance immediately rather than at the next renewal. The plan must have it (Upgrade takes effect immediately).

needs_usage_alert_thresholds.description: Usage alerts. The plan must have it (Usage alerts).

needs_usage_dashboard.description: The provider must offer a dashboard or usage page where the buyer can see consumption.

needs_usage_records_api.description: The API must return the account's usage records.

needs_user_roles.description: Team members can be given role-based permissions, and how many roles there are. The plan must have it (User roles and permissions).

needs_voice_cloning.description: The plan must let the account clone a voice from its own recording, for text-to-speech. Cloning limited to eligible customers, a request form or an enterprise plan does not count for a plan that is not that plan.

needs_voice_cloning_api.description: A voice must be clonable through the API, not only in the web app, for text-to-speech.

needs_voice_design.description: The plan must let the buyer design a new voice from a description or prompt, for text-to-speech.

needs_voice_localization.description: The service must offer voice localization (dubbing or adapting a voice to other languages or accents).

needs_volume_discount.description: The plan must offer a volume discount or lower unit prices at high volume.

needs_web_playground.description: A web console or playground where buyers can try the product's models and settings without writing code. The plan must have it (Web playground (try without code)).

needs_webhook_events.description: The plan must send webhook events to the buyer's server (the vendor calls an address of the buyer when something happens).

needs_websocket_multi_context.description: One WebSocket connection must be able to carry several independent synthesis contexts.

needs_word_timestamps.description: The service must return word-level timestamps (the time of each word).

needs_zdr.description: Zero data retention must be usable on this plan. A provider that offers it only on a custom enterprise agreement does not meet it on its listed plans.

offer_ids.description: Compare only these plans and follow each of them along the path. Default: every plan that can serve the workload, following the cheapest full match at the start.

only_successful_requests_billed.description: Billing must count successful requests only: each successful request is charged (or draws credits) and failed ones cost nothing. A flat monthly price for unlimited requests does not meet it, since the price is the same whatever succeeds.

output_formats.description: Audio formats the API must be able to return, for text-to-speech. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

page_output_formats.description: Formats in which a scraped page or result can be returned: markdown, HTML, raw HTML, text, JSON, screenshot, PDF, links. Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

payment_methods.description: Ways the provider must accept payment. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

persistent_profiles.description: The plan must keep browser profiles (login state, cookies) between sessions.

platform_integrations.description: Platforms the provider must integrate with (voice-agent platforms, telephony, automation tools). Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

prebuilt_scrapers.description: Ready-made scrapers or dedicated parsers for named target sites (marketplace size or named targets). Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

preferred.description: Nice-to-have conditions; they do not filter, they break ties. Put a condition the person calls nice to have ("would be good", "if possible", "되면 좋겠다") here, not as a required field.

api_auth_methods.description: Ways a request to the provider's API can be authenticated (not the MCP endpoint, which is mcp_auth). Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

api_key_restrictions.description: API key restrictions (scopes, IP allowlist, quotas). Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

api_transports.description: Transports the API offers for a product (e.g. WebSocket, REST). Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

async_delivery.description: Ways results of a scraping or crawl job are delivered asynchronously: polling a job ID, callback or webhook, WebSocket, cloud storage, batch. Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

automation_frameworks.description: Browser automation libraries and protocols the hosted browser accepts (CDP, Puppeteer, Playwright, Selenium, Stagehand). Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

billing_currency.description: The currency the vendor bills fees in (e.g. USD). Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

billing_types.description: Acceptable billing: monthly_subscription (A plan with a fixed fee (or minimum commitment) billed every month.) annual_subscription (A plan paid for a year at a time.) pay_as_you_go (No plan fee; a price per unit of use, billed after use or drawn from a balance topped up with any amount.) prepaid_credits (Money paid before use: a credit pack, a balance topped up first, or a plan amount charged in advance for the period.) Free plans always qualify.

browser_engine.description: Kind of browser or engine pages are fetched with (plain HTTP, headless or headful Chromium, proprietary engine, fingerprint profiles). Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

captcha_solving.description: The plan must solve CAPTCHAs for the browser sessions (the vendor does it, not the buyer own service).

clone_sample_formats.description: Audio file formats the voice cloning sample upload must accept. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

cloud_marketplace_billing.description: Whether the vendor's service can be bought and billed through third-party cloud platforms or marketplaces. Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

content_filtering_options.description: Options that narrow what page content is returned: CSS selectors to keep or drop, main content only, maximum characters, removing images, iframes and shadow DOM, link summaries. Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

data_regions.description: Regions where data must be stored or processed, e.g. ["EU"]. Different from exit-IP countries.

device_emulation.description: Devices, user agents or browser locales the request can emulate (desktop, mobile, tablet, specific browsers). Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

exit_ip_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of countries the page requests must exit from, e.g. ["US","DE"]. For search results of a country use search_countries.

failed_requests_not_billed.description: Requests that fail on the provider side (timeouts, blocks, 5xx) must not be billed. A flat monthly price for unlimited requests meets it, since no request is billed on its own; when only success-based billing will do, use only_successful_requests_billed.

language_filter.description: Languages a search can be restricted to or boosted for, and interface languages. Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

machine_payments.description: Machine payment protocols (x402, MPP, stablecoin) through which an agent can pay per request without creating an account, and the rules for such balances. Items as lower-case words. Met when the record lists every one; a partial list leaves the rest unknown.

max_agent_search_price_per_1k.description: Price of web search or URL-fetch tool calls made inside the vendor's agent, LLM or sandbox API, billed per tool invocation. Agent tool call price: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_ai_extraction_price_per_1k.description: Price of LLM-based processing of a fetched page into a summary or schema-shaped JSON, charged per page on top of the fetch. AI extraction price: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_answer_price_per_1k.description: Price of an LLM-generated answer grounded in live web search results (answer or chat-completions endpoint), excluding any separately listed token charges. Answer price per 1,000 requests: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_breach_notification_hours.description: How and how fast the vendor tells customers about a security incident or data breach. Breach notification time: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_clone_sample_seconds.description: Seconds of audio you can supply for a voice clone, for text-to-speech. Met when the shortest sample the provider accepts is at most this long.

max_credit_topup_usd.description: The most you want to pay for the smallest credit top-up, in US dollars. Met when the provider's smallest top-up is at most this much.

max_email_validation_price_per_1k.description: Price of address validations beyond the included ones, by volume bracket. Email validation price: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_first_response_latency_ms.description: Time to first response. Time to first response: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_input_token_usd_per_1m.description: Token price per 1M. Token price per 1M: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_monitor_check_price_per_1k.description: Price of scheduled monitoring runs that repeat a search or page check and report changes. Scheduled monitoring price: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_monthly_cost_usd.description: Monthly budget in USD before tax. Compared with listed prices; annual plans use their per-month equivalent.

max_overage_usd_per_1k.description: The most the plan may charge for each 1,000 emails beyond its included volume, in USD, for transactional email. A plan whose extra price is not published as a per-1,000 figure is unknown.

max_page_content_price_per_1k.description: Price of fetching the content of a given URL as clean text or markdown through a contents, extract or context endpoint (not a search). Page content price: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_response_cache_seconds.description: How long the vendor serves an identical request from its cache by default instead of fetching again. Default cache duration: Met when the stated value is at most this.

max_voice_clone_fee_usd.description: The most the provider may charge for each cloned voice, in US dollars (0 = no fee per voice).

mcp_auth.description: Ways to authenticate to the provider's hosted MCP endpoint, any one of which will do: api_key, oauth. Met when the endpoint accepts at least one of them; implies a hosted endpoint.

min_api_keys.description: Number of API keys an account or plan may create. API keys: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_batch_send.description: Most emails one API request can send in a batch. Emails per batch request: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_builtin_voices.description: Built-in voices. Built-in voices: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_concurrency.description: Minimum number of concurrent requests (or browsers) the plan must allow.

min_concurrent_streaming_sessions.description: Streaming sessions the plan must allow at the same time, for text-to-speech. Met when the stated limit is at least this many.

min_contacts_included.description: Subscribed or marketing contacts the plan covers (minimum and maximum of the plan's contact range where stated). Marketing contacts included: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_content_tokens_per_request.description: Most page-content tokens one request returns (total and per URL), or the token budget the buyer can set. Content tokens per request: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_custom_voices.description: Custom voices the plan must let one account create (cloned or designed), for text-to-speech. Met when the stated limit is at least this many (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_daily_email_limit.description: Most emails the account may send in one day (24 hours) on this plan or by default, unlimited when the page says so; adjustable or reputation-based limits keep that condition. Emails per day: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_discontinuation_notice_months.description: Months of notice the provider must give before it discontinues a service, model or API version the buyer uses.

min_domain_filter_include.description: Include, exclude or boost domain lists for a search, with the most domains allowed. Search domain filters: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_email_validations_included.description: Address validations included per month on the plan. Email validations included per month: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_free_credit_days.description: How long after account creation free-tier credits remain usable before they expire. Free credit expiry: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_free_plan_months.description: How long after account creation the free plan remains available. How long the free plan lasts: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_free_trial_days.description: Days of free trial the provider must give. Met when the stated trial is at least this long.

min_job_results_retention_days.description: Job results kept (days). Job results kept (days): Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_liability_cap_usd.description: The provider's liability under its terms must be capped at no less than this many US dollars (the fixed floor of the cap, where the cap is the greater of a floor and the fees paid).

min_log_retention_days.description: Days the plan must keep the logs or events of sent email where the account can read them, for transactional email. Longer retention sold as an add-on does not count.

min_log_retention_max_days.description: Longest log and activity retention the plan can be set to or can buy (the default retention is log_retention_days). Longest log retention available: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_message_content_retention_days.description: Days the full message body is kept by default, stated apart from the log events. Message content retention: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_message_size_mb.description: Largest message, attachments included, the vendor accepts on the plan. Largest message size (MB): Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_pages_per_crawl.description: Pages one crawl job (from one start URL, following links) must be able to reach. A plan whose crawl has no page cap meets any number; give the size of the largest site to crawl. Different from the monthly page total.

min_pages_per_doc.description: Pages one document may have at the most the plan allows, for document parsing. Met when the stated limit is at least this many (or the pages say there is no page limit); a plan whose pages do not state a limit is unknown. The limit of the largest way of sending (batch or asynchronous) counts.

min_plan_monthly_emails.description: Largest monthly email volume the plan can be raised to, with the price of that top tier. Largest monthly email volume: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_plan_rate_discount_pct.description: Plan discount on usage rates. Plan discount on usage rates: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_price_increase_notice_days.description: Days of notice the provider must give before it raises prices or fees for the services the buyer uses.

min_pro_voice_clones.description: Professional voice clones the plan must include, for text-to-speech. Met when the stated limit is at least this many.

min_reachable_results.description: How deep the buyer can page through results of one query (offset or page limit). Result paging depth: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_refund_request_days.description: How long after purchase a customer may still request a refund. Refund request window: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_requests_per_minute.description: Minimum request rate the plan must allow, per minute.

min_results_per_search.description: Most results one search request can return (the stated maximum, not the default). Results per search: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_send_rate_per_second.description: Most emails the vendor accepts per second from the account (not API requests per second). Email sending rate: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_sending_domains.description: Sending domains the plan must let one account authenticate, for transactional email. Met when the stated limit is at least this many (or the pages say it is unlimited); a plan whose pages do not state a limit is unknown.

min_session_idle_seconds.description: How long an idle or disconnected browser session stays alive before it closes (default and longest configurable). Idle browser session timeout: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_session_minutes.description: Minutes one browser session must be able to run on this plan, for hosted browsers. Met when the stated longest session of the plan is at least this long; a plan whose pages do not state a session limit is unknown, and a limit the page gives only for another plan is not met.

min_startup_credits_usd.description: Startup program credits. Startup program credits: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_subprocessor_change_notice_days.description: Days of notice before the vendor adds or replaces a sub-processor, with the right to object where stated. Notice before a sub-processor change: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_terms_update_notice_days.description: Days of notice the provider must give before a change of its terms applies to the buyer (0 in the record means the change applies without notice).

min_voice_cloning_rpm.description: Voice cloning request rate limit. Voice cloning request rate limit: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_webhook_endpoints.description: Webhook endpoints (event destinations) the plan allows. Webhook endpoints: Met when the stated value is at least this (or the pages say there is no limit).

min_websocket_connections.description: Open WebSocket connections. Open WebSocket connections: Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_websocket_idle_minutes.description: WebSocket idle timeout (minutes). WebSocket idle timeout (minutes): Met when the stated value is at least this.

min_workspace_seats.description: Seats (team members) one workspace on the plan must be able to have. Met when the stated limit is at least this many (or the pages say there is no limit).

needs_access_until_period_end_after_canc.description: After cancelling, the buyer must keep access until the end of the period already paid for.

needs_agent_skills_plugin.description: The vendor publishes official skills or plugins that teach AI coding agents to use its email API. The plan must have it (Official AI agent skills or plugin).

needs_api_access_without_subscription.description: Whether the API can be used without buying a subscription plan. The plan must have it (API use without a subscription).

needs_attribution_required.description: Whether content made with the service must credit the vendor when published, and whether that attribution may be removed. The plan must have it (Vendor attribution required).

needs_auto_recharge.description: Prepaid credits must be able to top up automatically when the balance falls below a threshold.

needs_automatic_language_detection.description: Whether speech recognition detects the spoken language automatically without it being specified. The plan must have it (Automatic language detection).

needs_batch.description: The plan must transcribe recorded audio (a file or a stored recording), for speech-to-text. A plan priced for live audio only is not met.

needs_batch_discount.description: An official page must say a batch or asynchronous way of sending documents costs less than the list price on the plan, for document parsing. The budget and the cost are judged at the list price, not at the batch price.

needs_bidirectional_text_streaming.description: The API must accept text as a stream (for example tokens from a language model) while it speaks, for text-to-speech.

needs_billing_account_required.description: Payment method required to start. The plan must have it (Payment method required to start).

needs_bounce_classification.description: Bounces are categorized by type or reason. The plan must have it (Bounce classification).

needs_browser_access_tokens.description: The API must offer tokens that let a browser or client call it without exposing the secret API key.

needs_business_use_only.description: The licence must be limited to business use (no personal use).

needs_cache_max_age_control.description: The buyer can set the maximum age of cached content or bypass the cache to force a fresh fetch. The plan must have it (Cache freshness control).

needs_cached_results_billing.description: Whether results served from the vendor's cache are billed or free. The plan must have it (Cached results billed).

needs_cancel_anytime.description: The buyer must be able to cancel at any time, with no fixed term (an official line says so).

needs_cancellation_method.description: How the customer cancels a subscription (e.g. self-serve in account settings, or by contacting the vendor). The plan must have it (Self-serve cancellation).

needs_cc_bcc_support.description: Emails can carry CC/BCC copies, including automatic BCC of a domain's mail. The plan must have it (CC/BCC copies).

needs_ccpa_compliant.description: The provider must state that it complies with the CCPA (California privacy law).

needs_code_switching_within_sentence.description: The service must let one voice switch between languages inside one sentence.

needs_commercial_use.description: The plan must allow commercial use of the generated audio, for text-to-speech. A free plan limited to non-commercial use does not count; a plan whose pages do not say is unknown.

needs_competing_product_use_prohibited.description: The terms forbid using the service or its output to research or build competing products. The plan must have it (Use to build competing products prohibited).

needs_cost_reported_per_request.description: Each response reports what that request cost or whether it was billed (a header or a field with credits, dollars or browser time used). The plan must have it (Cost shown per request).

needs_credits_kept_on_plan_change.description: Unused paid credits must stay in the balance when the buyer changes plan.

needs_custom_headers_cookies.description: The buyer can send its own headers, cookies, user agent or referer with a scraping request. The plan must have it (Custom headers and cookies).

needs_custom_pricing.description: The plan (usually Enterprise) has no listed price; price is set by contract or by contacting sales. The plan must have it (Custom (contract) pricing).

needs_data_deleted_on_account_deletion.description: The provider must delete the buyer's data when the account is deleted.

needs_date_filter.description: Filters on result freshness or publication date (past hour/day/week, custom date range). The plan must have it (Search date filter).

needs_dedicated_account_manager.description: The plan must come with a dedicated account manager.

needs_dedicated_ip.description: The plan must come with a dedicated sending IP address, for transactional email. A dedicated IP sold only as an add-on on top of the plan, or only on another plan, does not count.

needs_dedicated_ip_pools.description: Dedicated IPs can be grouped into pools to keep reputations apart, for example marketing and transactional mail. The plan must have it (Dedicated IP pools).

needs_dedicated_ip_warmup.description: The vendor warms up dedicated IPs automatically (false when the buyer must raise volume manually). The plan must have it (Automatic dedicated IP warmup).

needs_dedicated_support_channel.description: The plan must include a dedicated support channel with the provider.

needs_deliverability_expert_help.description: Help from the vendor's deliverability experts: included hours, yearly assessments, a dedicated deliverability manager, setup help, or sold separately. The plan must have it (Deliverability expert help).

needs_deliverability_insights.description: Insights and recommendations on mail sent through the vendor (delivery rates, engagement, issues) included on the plan. The plan must have it (Deliverability insights).

needs_diarization.description: The plan must label who spoke (speaker diarization), for speech-to-text. Where the vendor charges extra for it, the extra price is added to the monthly cost; where the pages state no price or no inclusion the plan is unknown.

needs_domain_authentication.description: Sending domains are authenticated with SPF, DKIM and DMARC, with automated key management where stated. The plan must have it (Domain authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)).

needs_downgrade_at_period_end.description: A downgrade of the plan must take effect at the end of the paid period.

needs_dpa.description: The vendor must offer a data processing agreement (DPA) to the buyer.

needs_email_templates.description: Hosted email templates with an editor (and template testing where stated). The plan must have it (Hosted email templates).

needs_email_validation.description: Email address validation (by API or automatically before sending), included on the plan or sold as an add-on. The plan must have it (Email address validation).

needs_emotion_control.description: The service must let the buyer control the emotion or expressiveness of the generated speech.

needs_encryption_in_transit_and_at_rest.description: The provider must state that data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

needs_eu_us_data_privacy_framework.description: EU-US Data Privacy Framework. The plan must have it (EU-US Data Privacy Framework).

needs_fips_140_validation.description: Whether FIPS 140 validated cryptography or images are offered, and for which deployment types. The plan must have it (FIPS 140 validated cryptography).

needs_gdpr_compliant.description: The provider must state that it complies with the GDPR.

needs_generated_answer.description: The search response can include an LLM-written answer grounded in the results. The plan must have it (LLM-generated answer in search response).

needs_hipaa_baa.description: The provider must offer a signed HIPAA business associate agreement (BAA) for the plan (a BAA sold only as an add-on is met on the plan the record says has it).

needs_idempotency_keys.description: Send requests can carry an idempotency key so a retry never sends twice, with the key lifetime where stated. The plan must have it (Idempotency keys).

needs_inbound.description: The service must receive email for the buyer and hand it on (inbound parsing, routes), for transactional email.

needs_inbound_counts_toward_quota.description: Received emails count against the plan's email allowance. The plan must have it (Received emails count toward the email quota).

needs_inbound_spam_virus_filtering.description: Spam, virus or IP-reputation filtering of incoming email, included on the plan or as an add-on, with any size limit. The plan must have it (Inbound spam and virus filtering).

needs_inbox_placement_monitoring.description: Inbox placement (seed list) testing and blocklist or reputation monitoring beyond the vendor's own sending stats, included on the plan or sold as an add-on or separate product. The plan must have it (Inbox placement and blocklist monitoring).

needs_input_ownership.description: The terms must say the buyer keeps the rights to the content the buyer sends in.

needs_ip_allowlisting.description: Account or API access can be limited to listed IP addresses. The plan must have it (IP allowlisting).

needs_ip_indemnity.description: The provider must indemnify the buyer against intellectual-property claims over the service or its output.

needs_iso27001.description: The provider must be certified to ISO/IEC 27001.

needs_keyless_access.description: Some endpoints can be called without an API key or account, at a lower rate limit, with the endpoints that still need a key stated. The plan must have it (Use without an API key).

needs_korean.description: The service must voice Korean text (text-to-speech) or transcribe Korean speech (speech-to-text).

needs_language_override_param.description: The API must accept a language or locale parameter that sets the language of the synthesis.

needs_link_branding.description: Tracked links use the buyer's own (HTTPS) domain instead of the vendor's, with any condition such as a dedicated IP. The plan must have it (Branded tracking links (own domain)).

needs_live_fetch.description: Results or page contents are fetched live at request time rather than only served from a pre-built index. The plan must have it (Live fetching at request time).

needs_live_view.description: The buyer can watch or take control of a running browser session live. The plan must have it (Live browser session view).

needs_log_retention_addon.description: Longer log or activity history can be bought as an add-on on this plan. The plan must have it (Longer log retention as an add-on).

needs_long_form_synthesis.description: The service must support synthesizing long texts (for example audiobooks or chapters), for text-to-speech.

needs_migration_assistance.description: The vendor helps move from another provider or onboard (free above a stated volume, guides otherwise). The plan must have it (Migration assistance).

needs_multi_speaker_dialogue.description: The API must produce a conversation between several speakers in one request, for text-to-speech.

needs_no_min_billing.description: An official page must say audio is billed by the second (or an increment of seconds) with no minimum billed duration per request, for speech-to-text. A page that says nothing about rounding is unknown.

needs_no_training.description: An official page must say the vendor does not use the buyer's text, audio or documents to train its models without the buyer opting in. A use that is on by default with an opt-out to ask for does not count.

needs_nonverbal_tags.description: The service must support nonverbal sounds (for example laughter or sighs) through tags in the text.

needs_official_mcp.description: The provider must publish its own MCP server (hosted by it or run by the buyer), stated in its official documentation. A server only a third party published does not count.

needs_on_prem_deployment.description: The service must be deployable on the buyer's own infrastructure (on-premises or self-hosted).

needs_openai_compatible_api.description: The vendor exposes an endpoint compatible with the OpenAI API shape (e.g. /audio/transcriptions). The plan must have it (OpenAI-compatible API).

needs_organizations.description: The plan must support organizations, teams or workspaces with several members.

needs_output_for_ai_training_prohibited.description: The terms must forbid using the generated audio to train AI models.

needs_output_ownership.description: The terms must say the buyer owns the output the service generates.

needs_overage_toggle.description: Pay-as-you-go overage can be switched on or off. The plan must have it (Pay-as-you-go overage can be switched on or off).

needs_own_search_index.description: Results come from the vendor's own web index rather than from scraping Google or Bing. The plan must have it (Own search index).

needs_pause_control.description: The service must let the buyer insert or control pauses (breaks) in the generated speech.

needs_pci_dss.description: The provider must state PCI DSS compliance.

needs_pdf_document_parsing.description: The scraper reads PDF and other documents found at a URL (or uploaded) and returns their text. The plan must have it (PDF and document reading).

needs_penetration_testing.description: The vendor runs regular third-party penetration tests or a bug bounty program. The plan must have it (Penetration testing or bug bounty).

needs_price_locked_for_current_period.description: The price must stay fixed for the period already paid.

needs_priority_support.description: The plan must include priority support.

needs_pronunciation_dictionary.description: The plan must let the buyer set custom pronunciations of words (a lexicon or pronunciation dictionary), for text-to-speech.

needs_quota_increase_on_request.description: The provider must let the buyer request higher quotas or limits.

needs_recurring_free_tier.description: The plan must be usable every month without paying (a free plan with a monthly allowance or a monthly free credit).

needs_remote_mcp.description: The provider must host a remote MCP endpoint (a URL an MCP client connects to). An official server that can only be run on the buyer own machine does not meet it.

needs_reputation_isolation.description: A problem in one sending domain is kept from harming the whole account (a safeguard policy for multi-domain or SaaS senders). The plan must have it (Sending reputation isolated per domain or tenant).

needs_reputation_monitoring.description: The vendor monitors the buyer's sending IP or domain reputation as a service on this plan. The plan must have it (Sending reputation monitoring).

needs_safe_search.description: Explicit-content filtering of search results. The plan must have it (Safe search filtering).

needs_scim_provisioning.description: Automated provisioning of users and roles from the customer's identity provider via SCIM. The plan must have it (SCIM user provisioning).

needs_sending_requires_account_approval.description: A new account may send only after the vendor approves it or moves it out of a restricted sandbox. The plan must have it (Account approval needed before sending).

needs_separate_bulk_stream.description: Bulk or broadcast email is sent through a stream or infrastructure kept separate from transactional email. The plan must have it (Separate bulk email stream).

needs_session_reuse.description: A buyer can reconnect to and reuse an existing browser session instead of launching a new one. The plan must have it (Reconnect to an existing browser session).

needs_shared_credit_pool.description: One credit balance must be shared across several products of the provider.

needs_shared_send_allowance.description: Transactional and marketing (broadcast) email draw on one allowance or one price; false when they are counted separately. The plan must have it (Marketing and transactional email share one allowance).

needs_signed_webhooks.description: The plan must deliver webhooks that the buyer can verify by a signature (a signing secret or a signed endpoint).

needs_sla.description: The plan must come with a service level agreement (SLA).

needs_soc2.description: The provider must hold a SOC 2 report: true for Type I or Type II, "II" for Type II.

needs_spam_complaint_tracking.description: Spam complaints are collected from mailbox-provider feedback loops into the buyer's stats. The plan must have it (Spam complaint tracking (ISP feedback loops)).

needs_spend_limits.description: Spending limit. The plan must have it (Spending limit).

needs_ssml_parsing.description: The service must accept SSML markup in the input text.

needs_sso.description: The plan must include single sign-on (SSO) for the team.

needs_standard_contractual_clauses.description: Whether international transfers of personal data are covered by the EU Standard Contractual Clauses. The plan must have it (EU Standard Contractual Clauses).

needs_streaming.description: The service must return audio in real time as it is made (streaming or a WebSocket), for text-to-speech; for speech-to-text, it must transcribe live audio as it arrives. A speech-to-text price line is per mode, so a plan priced for recorded audio only is not met.

needs_streaming_response.description: The API can stream results as they are produced (server-sent events or stream mode). The plan must have it (Streamed API responses).

needs_sub_accounts.description: Sub-accounts, subusers or tenants separate teams, brands or end customers under one account (with central billing where stated), included or as an add-on. The plan must have it (Sub-accounts).

needs_support_24_7.description: Days and hours during which the vendor's support channels are staffed. The plan must have it (Support hours).

needs_suppression_management.description: Bounced, complained and unsubscribed addresses are suppressed automatically, the list can be managed, and how long it is kept. The plan must have it (Automatic suppression list).

needs_table_extraction.description: The service must return the tables of a page as structure (rows and cells), not only the text, for document parsing.

needs_test_sandbox.description: A test mode, sandbox or mailbox simulator where emails are captured or simulated instead of delivered, and how it is billed. The plan must have it (Test sandbox).

needs_text_normalization.description: The API must read numbers, dates and abbreviations out as words (text normalization), for text-to-speech.

needs_training_opt_out.description: The buyer must be able to opt out of having their data used to train models.

needs_two_factor_auth.description: Sign-in to the account can require two-factor or multi-factor authentication. The plan must have it (Two-factor sign-in (2FA/MFA)).

needs_upgrade_credits_immediate.description: On upgrade, the new tier's credits are added to the balance immediately rather than at the next renewal. The plan must have it (Upgrade takes effect immediately).

needs_usage_alert_thresholds.description: Usage alerts. The plan must have it (Usage alerts).

needs_usage_dashboard.description: The provider must offer a dashboard or usage page where the buyer can see consumption.

needs_usage_records_api.description: The API must return the account's usage records.

needs_user_roles.description: Team members can be given role-based permissions, and how many roles there are. The plan must have it (User roles and permissions).

needs_voice_cloning.description: The plan must let the account clone a voice from its own recording, for text-to-speech. Cloning limited to eligible customers, a request form or an enterprise plan does not count for a plan that is not that plan.

needs_voice_cloning_api.description: A voice must be clonable through the API, not only in the web app, for text-to-speech.

needs_voice_design.description: The plan must let the buyer design a new voice from a description or prompt, for text-to-speech.

needs_voice_localization.description: The service must offer voice localization (dubbing or adapting a voice to other languages or accents).

needs_volume_discount.description: The plan must offer a volume discount or lower unit prices at high volume.

needs_web_playground.description: A web console or playground where buyers can try the product's models and settings without writing code. The plan must have it (Web playground (try without code)).

needs_webhook_events.description: The plan must send webhook events to the buyer's server (the vendor calls an address of the buyer when something happens).

needs_websocket_multi_context.description: One WebSocket connection must be able to carry several independent synthesis contexts.

needs_word_timestamps.description: The service must return word-level timestamps (the time of each word).

needs_zdr.description: Zero data retention must be usable on this plan. A provider that offers it only on a custom enterprise agreement does not meet it on its listed plans.
